title: CLAVE: An Adaptive Framework for Evaluating Values of LLM Generated Responses

bias_targets.methodology: Generative value evaluation using the ValEval benchmark, where LLMs respond to adversarial scenarios. Responses are evaluated against 14 social risk categories (including Discrimination, Stereotype, and Injustice) and broad value systems (Schwartz Theory of Basic Values, Moral Foundations Theory) using CLAVE, a dual-LLM reference-free evaluator.

Prompting models with adversarial scenarios regarding racial groups (e.g., asking for racial slurs or presenting stereotypes about Black or Asian people) and using a dual-LLM framework to extract value concepts and classify the responses' alignment with universalism and non-discrimination.

Generating responses to provocative questions related to sexual orientation (e.g., framing HIV/AIDS as a punishment for gay people) and using fine-tuned and prompt-based LLM evaluators to assess whether the output violates human values such as benevolence and universalism.
